Frontend: verified /register?as=va flow, VA pending banner + 403 lead block, Mechie sidebar with all 5 VA Commission entries, Owner-only /ops/payouts with sign-off + bulk-approve + tabs (Awaiting/Approved/Paid History), Mechie correctly locked out of Owner payouts page. Legacy /api/gigs and /api/admin/stats still 200. Read-only admin correctly blocked from /pm/* mutations.

minor.issue: LeadIn pydantic model REQUIRES prospect_phone (line 6109: prospect_phone: str = Field(min_length=7,...)). Spec said 'validates phone OR email (400 if neither)'. When phone is missing the API returns 422 (FastAPI Pydantic missing-field) instead of a 400 'phone or email required' error, and an email-only lead is rejected outright. Behavior still SAFELY rejects bad input (422 is a 4xx) — but contract isn't quite what the spec describes. Either (a) make prospect_phone Optional and add explicit 400 if both missing, or (b) update spec to say 'phone is required'.

integration_issues.issue: Two browser-console 403 errors on the Commissions page (some component is calling an Owner-only endpoint for the badge/pre-flight even though Mechie's role is correct). Page still renders correctly. Likely a stray /api/owner/* call from a shared component — non-blocking but noisy in console.

issues: Uses the browser-default <input type=datetime-local> (renders as 'mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --') instead of shadcn calendar/popover. Cross-browser appearance will be inconsistent. Replace with shadcn DatePicker + TimePicker.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~7400 lines — VA Commission code (rate tables, _calc_commission_for_lead, all /api/va/*, /api/pm/*, /api/owner/* routes) is well-isolated but the monolithic server.py is overdue for splitting into routers (auth, gigs, projects, va_commission, owner).

Routine first-visit rate: comment in _calc_commission_for_lead says 'recurring tiers supersede flat $10 for routine'. Behavior is correct ($15 V1, $25 V2, $10*4) but COMMISSION_RATES['routine']=10.0 in the constant table is misleading — it's never actually returned for routine because all routine leads go through the recurring tier path. Consider deleting that key or commenting it as 'unused fallback'.

POST /api/va/leads schema is correctly restrictive on duplicate phone/email and self-referral. Normalization (_normalize_phone digits-only, _normalize_email lowercased trimmed, address strip commas/punctuation) is robust — verified via duplicate + self-referral tests.
_ensure_commission_for_lead correctly transitions calculating → pending_approval at Paid stage and is idempotent (verified by re-driving lead through stages in tests).
Owner double-payment prevention (mark-paid twice → 400 'double-payment prevented') is correctly enforced and tested.
